titleTr: İşte bir gizem: must ve can't ile tahmin

explainTr: 'Must' sadece zorunluluk için değildir: bir şeyin büyük ihtimalle doğru olduğunu da gösterir. Bir ipucu görüp 'eminim' dersen must be kullanırsın: The light is on. Someone must be here.
'Can't' ise 'olamaz, imkânsız' anlamında kullanılır: She can't be at home. I saw her at school. Olumlu çıkarım için must, olumsuz çıkarım için can't kullanırsın; 'mustn't' bunun için kullanılmaz.
İkisinden sonra da yalın fiil gelir, özne ne olursa olsun -s eklenmez: He must be tired. It can't be true. Emin değilsen might kullan.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede çıkarım 'olmalı' ve 'olamaz' ile yapılır: 'Yorgun olmalı' = He must be tired. 'O olamaz' = It can't be him. İngilizcede 'must' kuvvetli olumlu tahmin, 'can't' kuvvetli olumsuz tahmin; zayıf tahmin için might kullan.

examples.en: The lights are on. Someone must be here.
She can't be sick. I saw her car.
He must be very tired after work.
That can't be the right key.

options: He is not allowed to be home.

exercises.whyTr: Çıkarımda can't be = olamaz, eminim değil.

exercises.whyTr: Tatilde olduğu için o olamaz: can't be.

exercises.whyTr: Önce olan iş Past Perfect: had found.

reading.title: The mystery in room 12
reading.text:
On Tuesday morning, something strange happened at Lincoln Elementary School. Hafsa arrived early to work as a substitute for Ms. Lopez, the art teacher. But the sub plan was not on the desk, and the room was empty.

"The lights are on," Hafsa thought. "Someone must be here." She noticed a coffee cup on the desk. It was still warm, so the person can't be far away. Then she noticed something else: the supply closet was locked, and the key was missing.

She went to the front office. Mr. Brown listened to her story and frowned. "That's odd. Ms. Lopez is never late, so she must be somewhere in the building. And she can't be sick. I saw her car in the parking lot." He looked at the clock. "It's eight o'clock. The students will arrive in thirty minutes."

Together they walked back to the classroom. Suddenly they heard a noise from the closet. Someone was knocking from the inside! Mr. Brown found a spare key and opened the door. It was Ms. Lopez. "I went in to get some paint," she explained, "and the lock closed behind me. I had my bag and the sub plan in my hands, so they must be in there too." She laughed. "I have been in that closet for twenty minutes!"

Hafsa was relieved. The mystery was solved, and her first day already had a good story to tell.

questions.q: Why did Hafsa think someone must be in the room?
options: The lights were on and the coffee was warm.
questions.whyTr: Metin: lights on, warm coffee cup, 'Someone must be here.'

questions.q: What did Hafsa notice about the supply closet?
options: It was locked and the key was missing.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the supply closet was locked, and the key was missing.'

questions.q: How did Mr. Brown know Ms. Lopez was not sick?
options: He saw her car in the parking lot.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'she can't be sick. I saw her car in the parking lot.'
Metin: 'It was Ms. Lopez' knocking from inside the closet.

writing.promptTr: İşte ya da okulda yaşadığın küçük bir gizemi anlat. must, can't ve might ile çıkarım yap (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write about a small mystery at work or at school. Use must, can't and might to make guesses.
writing.model: Yesterday I noticed a strange problem at the school. The coffee machine was empty, and my pen was missing from the desk. First I thought, someone must be using the machine. But it can't be a teacher, because everyone was in a meeting. Maybe the student helper took the pen, or it might be a simple mistake. I looked for clues. In the end, I found my pen in my bag! It was obvious, and I felt silly. Now I always check before I ask.
checklistTr: En az bir 'must be' ve bir 'can't be' kullandın mı?
Emin olmadığın bir fikirde 'might' kullandın mı?
Must / can't'ten sonra yalın fiil var mı?
